title: Conditions of Sale, Extract: Authority and Timing for Setting or Amending a Fulfilment Slot
content:
1. A slot is set, or an order amended, only against a change request standing as confirmed by the customer for that
   order. The confirmation relied on is the confirmation standing on the retailer's own record of that change request,
   read before the slot is set or the order amended, and the change request must stand against that same order; the
   record also carries which kind of request it is. A customer's wish expressed without such a confirmed request
   standing on the record is not the authority this clause asks for.

2. An order under Northbeam Purchase Orders and Fulfilment may not be amended later than the fulfilment service's
   amendment cutoff hours before the slot it stands on.

3. Cutoff hours are counted as elapsed hours back from the start of the booked window, and a cutoff that falls outside
   trading hours is not moved. The day and window the order stands booked for are taken from the order's own record of
   the booked slot. The boundary is not met by equality: the amendment stands only while more than the service's cutoff
   hours remain before the start of the booked window, and once exactly that many hours remain the cutoff has been
   reached and the order may no longer be amended.

4. A slot is offered no earlier than the fulfilment service's least lead days after the order and ordinarily no later
   than its longest, in one of the windows that service offers. A dock slot needs the service's dock booking notice.

## The cutoff on both sides of the boundary (hypothetical hours)

Take an order standing on a booked window that opens at a stated hour, on a service whose amendment cutoff is stated
in hours. An amendment made while more hours remain before that window opens than the cutoff figure is inside the
time; an amendment made when exactly the cutoff figure of hours remains is outside it, the boundary not being met by
equality; and an amendment made when fewer hours remain is later still and equally outside it. Where the moment at
which the cutoff falls lies outside trading hours, it stays where the counting back puts it and is not carried forward
to the next trading hour.

## Points of judgement

**What makes a slot or an amendment properly authorised?** A change request for that order standing as confirmed by
the customer on the retailer's record, at the time the slot is set or the order amended.

**From what moment are the cutoff hours counted back?** From the start of the booked window, in elapsed hours.

**How early may a slot fall?** No earlier than the service's least lead days after the order, and ordinarily no later
than its longest, within the windows that service offers.
